trials.name: hypothetical
trials.output:
You wake to foghorns and gulls outside your window. Harbor City is already stirring: fishing boats return with the morning catch, ferries cut across the bay, and cafés open along the waterfront.

After breakfast, you commute by tram or water taxi past warehouses converted into studios and markets. Lunch might be fresh seafood from a dockside stall. In the afternoon, sea mist gives way to sunshine, drawing people to parks, piers, and crowded shopping streets.

After work, you stroll along the marina as neon signs ripple across the water. Dinner is somewhere overlooking the bay, followed by live music in the old port district. You fall asleep to the low hum of ships and the glow of the lighthouse sweeping across the harbor.
